description: Add or update a per-channel permission overwrite for a single member, allowing and/or denying specific permissions. Merges with the member's existing overwrite. Requires the Manage Roles permission. Use discord_set_role_permission to target a whole role instead.

allow.description: Permission flag names to allow, e.g. ['ViewChannel'] (or the same array JSON-encoded as a string). Uses Discord PermissionsBitField flag names.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel to set the overwrite on.

deny.description: Permission flag names to deny (array, or JSON-encoded array string).

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the server audit log.

user_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the member to grant/deny permissions for.

name: discord_set_member_permission
